data.name: Help_Confirmation_Body
data.value: Requests that move the machine (wheel start, carriage traverse, positioning, homing, cycles, arm calibration), downloads (job, step matrix, setpoints, overrides), deletes and clears, saving tuning or configuration are asked on the dialog line first. Vertical keys 7 / 8 then become "✕ Cancel / ✓ Confirm": ✓ or Enter does it; ✕ or Esc drops it; no answer in 5 seconds drops it. Stops (wheel stop, carriage stop), display switches and coolant are not asked.

data.name: Help_Intro
data.value: Pick a topic under "Contents" or "Index", or type a word under "Search". The form stays usable while help is open; "Exit help" or Esc returns to the diagram.

data.name: Help_Keypad_Body
data.value: Tap a value to select it (cyan; the dialog line shows meaning, unit and range), tap again for the keypad. "↵ Enter" takes the value and moves to the next field; out-of-range values are refused with the reason. The decimal point is always ".". Values that act on the machine at once (setpoints, overrides, step matrix) turn red and are written only after you confirm.

data.name: Help_ManualGrinding_Body
data.value: Top: positions (X, X1, Z, U) and mechanism lamps; middle: wheel, headstock and carriage windows; bottom: position strip along the roll body. Setpoints and overrides: tap a field to change it; it turns red and is written only after "✓ Confirm". −5 / +5 change the overrides. Headstock start/stop and direction are on the button panel. Carriage traverse: enter speed and stroke (or tap the strip), press "Carriage traverse…" and confirm; press again to stop (not asked). Position ▸: carriage to Z, to ¼ / ½ / ¾ of the body, arms to roll / home, infeed to safe position — each is confirmed. The pendant's axis and factor are shown on the channel row; jog with the pendant, not on screen.

data.name: Help_ProfileSegment_Body
data.value: A profile is a chain of segments: each has a start Z (first segment only) and a length L; later segments start where the previous one ends. Crown, taper, CVC, sine and point table each have their own parameters; point tables choose an interpolation ("Interpolation ▸"). In symmetric editing only the headstock side is edited and the tailstock side mirrors it; tapers face the end by themselves. Checked as you type: a segment past the body or an invalid length turns red and Save goes grey.

data.name: Help_SoftKeys_Body
data.value: The bottom row picks the function group of this area (F1–F8; ">" pages when there are more than 8); the right column holds the actions of that group (Shift+F1–F8). Vertical slot 8 is "« Back" in a sub menu or "≡▸" when there are more than 8 keys; while something waits for confirmation or has edits, 7 / 8 are cancel / confirm. A grey key does nothing when pressed; the dialog line says why (missing tag, emergency stop, role, running …). Area menu: F10 or the area tile at the top right; the left bar jumps straight to common areas (Ctrl+1…7).

data.name: Help_StepParameters_Body
data.value: The step sequence is on the left; on the right the diagram of the selected step above and its parameter form below. The parameter under the cursor lights up on the diagram, and the dialog line gives its meaning, unit and range. "Insert step ▸" picks a step by category; "Defaults" resets the step (asked first). Stock allocation and cross-step checks run on save; a program with errors cannot be saved or used for a job.
